warnings: Section callouts print a slashed-rectangle symbol before the size (rectangular tube ▯-100x50x2.3 mm.) — read as a rectangular hollow (box) section, designation RHS (section 6a), the print kept in printed_as.

Chords on every truss are rectangular tube 100x50x2.3 (each callout has leaders to the top chord, bottom chord and a vertical). T3 and T5 also print a separate rectangular tube 75x45x2.3 callout on their verticals — kept as web_steel_section, a new key (no existing field holds a second section on one member).

T1 and T4 are mono-pitch: the depth grows along the span. T1 prints 0.670 at the T3 end and 1.474 (= 0.670 + 0.804) at the T2 end; height_mm is the largest printed depth. T2, T3, T5 print one depth each; T4 prints 0.796 at its T5 end.

The elevations print no grid bubbles; supports were matched to the S-03 plan from the T-marks and piers drawn on them (see the grid master warnings). Panel chains are recorded in the grid master dimension_chains[].
อะเส C-100x50x20x2.3 mm. (หลังอะเสระดับ+3.36) is called out on Trusses T2 and T4 at rows A and B — the member itself is recorded on the S-03 view-2 plan.
